question: Should OpenClaw canonically export and advertise `CLAW.md` for experimental single-agent Claw packages before the package-versus-composition, role, routing, and policy contract is defined?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically correct while still committing users to a public filename and authoring boundary that the current design discussion says is unresolved.

options.title: Defer canonicalization
options.body: Keep the PR paused until the package/composition contract determines the correct public manifest boundary and filename.

options.title: Approve an experimental canonical format
options.body: Explicitly accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental single-agent package contract and land this slice only after its lifecycle stack predecessors.

options.title: Retain JSON as canonical export
options.body: Keep JSON export canonical for now and revisit human-authored manifest syntax after the broader format decision.

recommendation.title: Defer canonicalization
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until the package/composition contract determines the correct public manifest boundary and filename.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current comment articulates the exact unresolved product boundary that determines whether this format should be canonicalized now.
